notes: The repeated from before each coordinate genitive is a rule 103 function-word repetition, taken by the member it introduces rather than marked added; where the ASV writes no determiner the article is unrepresented and the preposition stays with the noun under rules 21 and 23.
τοῦ before πνικτοῦ takes the supplied nominal what under rule 22 with its case preposition riding along, the adjective keeping is strangled.
